Dr. Martinez, patient Robert Kim (age 41) presents with: Bipolar I disorder, manic episode with psychotic features, stabilized on lithium + olanzapine, day 7 inpatient. Relevant history: Bipolar I disorder (diagnosed age 25, 3 prior hospitalizations); Previous lithium toxicity (2023, renal dose adjustment); Hypothyroidism secondary to lithium (levothyroxine 75mcg). Current medications: Lithium 900mg BID (level 0.8 mEq/L today), Olanzapine 15mg QHS, Levothyroxine 75mcg daily, and 1 more.

The patient is approaching discharge. Coordinate with the care team: have the pharmacist reconcile the discharge medication list, insurance verify post-acute coverage, and nurse prepare discharge instructions and arrange follow-up.

Clinical calibration instructions: Pharmacist should call review_medication_list for the patient. Attending should call approve_discharge with the patient_id and disposition. Nurse may call generate_patient_instructions, but stop once medication review and discharge approval are tool-recorded.

Please reconcile the discharge medication list for Robert Kim (PT-38745): lithium 900mg BID, olanzapine 15mg QHS, levothyroxine 75mcg daily, plus the 4th current med. Flag any interactions and confirm renal-adjusted lithium dosing given his 2023 toxicity history.

Reviewing now. Running medication list reconciliation and interaction check for PT-38745. Lithium level 0.8 mEq/L is therapeutic; will confirm current renal function (last Cr) supports 900mg BID given 2023 toxicity. Standing by for the 4th med — please confirm (likely a PRN or sleep agent?) so I can complete reconciliation.

Reconciliation complete for PT-38745. Full list: Lithium 900mg BID (level 0.8 mEq/L, therapeutic), Olanzapine 15mg QHS, Levothyroxine 75mcg daily, Lorazepam 1mg PRN agitation (unused x48h). Interaction check: no clinically significant interactions. Lithium level is within range; please confirm current Cr/eGFR supports continuation at 900mg BID given 2023 toxicity history before discharge. Pending that confirmation, medication list is approved for discharge. Recommend outpatient lithium level + TSH + BMP in 1–2 weeks. Ready for your approve_discharge call.

Pharmacy approval recorded for PT-38745 discharge medication list (lithium 900mg BID, olanzapine 15mg QHS, levothyroxine 75mcg daily, lorazepam 1mg PRN). Pending your confirmation of current Cr/eGFR supporting continued lithium 900mg BID. Once confirmed, please proceed with approve_discharge.
Pharmacy reconciliation and interaction check are complete and clean for PT-38745. Pending your confirmation of current Cr/eGFR supporting lithium 900mg BID, please proceed with approve_discharge.
Confirmed: most recent BMP shows Cr 1.0, eGFR >60, stable from baseline. Lithium 900mg BID is appropriate to continue. Proceeding with discharge approval now. Thanks for the thorough reconciliation.

Discharge approved for PT-38745 (Robert Kim): home with outpatient psychiatry follow-up; lithium level, TSH, and BMP in 1-2 weeks. Med list reconciled by pharmacy (lithium 900mg BID, olanzapine 15mg QHS, levothyroxine 75mcg daily, lorazepam 1mg PRN). Please finalize discharge instructions and confirm follow-up appointment. Thanks all — closing the loop.
